import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import para, algo, numpy as np
prof={'groups':2,'jitter_ps':[2,2],'measurements':[[0,1,10,14],[0,1,10,25],[1,1,-13,0]]}
fab={'n':3,'interval_ns':1,'slice_ns':20,'offset_ns':8,'drift_ppb':[18,1,22],'heat':[[1,8,19,13]],'anchors':[[1,8,10],[2,5,15]],
     'links':[{'ends':[[2,1,1],[0,1,0]],'delay_ns':[6,1],'defer_rounds':[4,1]},{'ends':[[0,0,0],[1,1,0]],'delay_ns':[1,1],'defer_rounds':[8,8]},
              {'ends':[[0,0,0],[1,1,0]],'delay_ns':[1,7],'defer_rounds':[7,6]},{'ends':[[0,0,0],[2,1,1]],'delay_ns':[2,1],'defer_rounds':[4,8]},
              {'ends':[[1,0,1],[0,1,0]],'delay_ns':[3,4],'defer_rounds':[7,8]}],'slices':[[0,1,2,3,4]],'blackouts':[],'guards_ns':[2,3,8],'reconfig_ns':1}
plan = algo.compile_plan(prof, fab)
cal = para.calibrate(prof)
import topo
F = topo.Fabric(fab); H,_ = para.hop_tables(cal['upper_ps'], prof['jitter_ps'])
P,N = F.P,F.n
b=algo._flat_matrix(plan['bounds_as'],P,N); a=algo._flat_matrix(plan['age_rounds'],P,N); pf=algo._flat_matrix(plan['pred'],P,N)
anch = F.anch.T.reshape(-1).tolist()
bad=[]
for s in range(F.nstates):
    if b[s] is None: continue
    if anch[s]:
        if b[s]!=0 or a[s]!=0 or pf[s] is not None: bad.append(('anchor',s))
        continue
    pr=pf[s]
    u,k = pr
    pu,iu = u//N, u%N
    p,i = s//N, s%N
    if k == -1:
        ok = (iu==i) and (pu == (p-1)%P)
        wb = F.vtw()[u]; wa=1
    else:
        kc=k; sn=int(F.dc_src[kc]); dn=int(F.dc_dst[kc]); d=int(F.dc_d[kc]); q=int(F.dc_q[kc])
        Delta = d//T_ if False else d//F.T + (1 if d%F.T else 0) + q
        ok = (iu==sn) and (i==dn) and ((pu+Delta)%P==p)
        rho=int(F.rho_arr[pu]); 
        elig = rho>=8 and rho+d+8<=F.S
        wb = int(H[int(F.dc_gs[kc])][int(F.dc_gd[kc])]) + F.aging(dn,pu,d,q); wa=Delta
    if not ok: bad.append(('step',s,u,k))
    elif b[u]+wb != b[s] or a[u]+wa != a[s]: bad.append(('label',s,u,k,b[u],wb,b[s],a[u],wa,a[s]))
print(len(bad)); print(bad[:10])
